'''Varram''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] Secretary to the [[President/Legends|President]] of [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] [[Tai Cordan]] in the aftermath of the [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|Battle of Balmorra]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Though Cordan trusted him, a former [[Balmorran resistance]] member [[Zenith]] viewed Varram as paranoid for creating a funding a personal militia to guard Cordan. Zenith eventually asked for Varram's support in the parliamentary election for the new Balmorran government, which was granted to him.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Secretary Varram is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during Zenith's companion storyline.
